only_changed_leaves.before: Medium shot at a wooden upper-floor casement of a red-brick London house before dawn, one adult household maid in a plain seventeenth-century linen coif and dark wool gown leans out and looks toward distant orange firelight, her mature face visible in profile
only_changed_leaves.after: Exterior medium-wide view from a narrow London lane before dawn in 1666. An upper-floor wooden casement stands open in a red-brick house; one clearly adult household maid with mature facial features, in a plain linen coif and dark wool gown, leans her upper body through the window and faces in side profile toward a small orange glow beyond distant low gabled rooftops
